items.quote: Wir fordern Sie auf, den offenen Betrag bis spätestens 10.12.2026 zu zahlen.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis spätestens 10.12.2026'. This is a company (not an authority) deadline stated explicitly in the text, so no deemed-delivery or §187/188 BGB period counting is needed — the date stands as written. 10.12.2026 is a Thursday, not a weekend or public holiday in NRW, so no shift applies. Due date: 2026-12-10.

warnings: This is a reminder/dunning letter from a utility company (not an authority); the deadline is the calendar date printed in the letter and is not subject to the statutory deemed-delivery rules for authorities.

The letter threatens to suspend supply ('die Versorgung ... zu unterbrechen') if payment is not made — verify the arrears and account number against your own records or a previous bill before paying, and confirm the IBAN/payee name match via your bank's mandatory payee-name check before transferring money.
